column1: # Wide geometric --min-gain sweep to locate the plateau EDGES and its center.
# Prior 250-4000 sweep was statistically flat (5-way homogeneity p=0.12/0.27 on
# ntil-47/49) EXCEPT the lowest point mg250 degraded on ntil-47 -- a hint that
# the compiled default (100) sits near the LOW edge, not the center, and that
# the plateau extends well above 100 (4000 was still fine). This ladder brackets
# both sides: off -> default -> known-flat -> unexplored high, ~4x geometric.
# mg0 tests whether the snap mechanism matters at all; the high end should find
# the upper cliff (eps so large that improving moves snap to 0). Center of the
# resulting good band -> principled default. All other knobs at compiled defaults.
